requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area, so this is applied as a direct >= threshold on surface_area.
The user requires energy class D or better, so the filter includes A1 through D. Area, capacity, location near parks, and the childcare use are not energy columns and are not filtered here.
User prefers a commercial unit near parks. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded up to 75 so the threshold is not below that percentile.

output.explanation: Filters on the extracted requirements only: property_type 'Attività commerciali e assimilabili', surface_area >= 115, energy_class from A1 to D, green >= 75, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Results are ordered by distance from that point. Capacity for 15 people was not among the extracted requirements, so it is not filtered.
